_about: AI-assisted: researched and assembled with ChatGPT (OpenAI). See docs/AI_USAGE.md. Second-tier public OFAC designees from 2008 Wei/UWSA financial-network action. This file records historical designations and 2026 status checks, not personal drug charges or convictions. Empty regions reflect no source-supported individual operating-country claim. No inferred person-to-person edges, routes, private locations, or photos.
